title: 78-year-old Piston member hospitalized while leading transport strike
summary: MANILA, Philippines – Jeepney driver Tatay Elmer was hospitalized on the first day of the two-day nationwide transport strike led by Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Operator Nationwide…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Jeepney driver Tatay Elmer was hospitalized on the first day of the two-day nationwide transport strike led by Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Operator Nationwide (Piston), the group said in a social media post on Sept. 29. Tatay Elmer is currently confined at the Caloocan City Medical Center and remains unconscious, according to Piston.
